title: labels 1 3 words sentence case i18n
rule: Labels 1–3 words, sentence case, no articles/punctuation; independent sentences (not the first half of a sentence finished by the options) — i18n.
pass_when: Label is 1–3 words, sentence case, no articles/punctuation, and a full independent sentence (options don’t complete the label).
fail_when: Long label, Title Case, articles/punctuation, or “Choose your…” finished by the options (breaks i18n).
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: GOV.UK no-colons / Fluent top-align as this word-count rule. Overlap with Forms 54: beyond LIVE `visible_label` / `label_stays_visible`.
